The turn counter is\n        # advanced at resolution time because a resolution starts the next\n        # player's turn, while intermediate player actions (and travel turns)\n        # do not bump the counter.\n        last_player_row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND actor != ? \"\n            \"ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1\",\n            (campaign_id, row[\"owner\"]),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if last_player_row is None:\n            next_actor = players[(row[\"turn_number\"] - 1) % len(players)]\n        else:\n            last_player = last_player_row[\"actor\"]\n            try:\n                idx = players.index(last_player)\n            except ValueError:\n                idx = (row[\"turn_number\"] - 1) % len(players)\n            next_actor = players[(idx + 1) % len(players)]\n        new_turn_number = row[\"turn_number\"] + 1\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (campaign_id, next_seq, \"resolution\", row[\"owner\"], text),\n        )\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n            (next_actor, new_turn_number, campaign_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"sequence\": next_seq,\n        \"kind\": \"resolution\",\n        \"actor\": row[\"owner\"],\n        \"text\": text,\n        \"next_actor\": next_actor,\n        \"turn_number\": new_turn_number,\n    }\n\n\n\ndef increment_nudge_count(camp_id, message):\n    \"\"\"Increment the nudge counter for a play campaign and log the nudge event.\n\n    Returns the new count on success, or None if the campaign is missing.\n    \"\"\"\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n            (camp_id,),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        new_count = row[\"nudge_count\"] + 1\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = ? AND encounter_id = ?\",\n        (camp_id, enc_id),\n    ).fetchall()\n    combatants = [\n        {\"id\": r[\"monster_id\"], \"name\": r[\"name\"], \"kind\": \"monster\", \"initiative\": r[\"initiative\"]} for r in rows\n    ]\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT member, name, initiative FROM play_encounter_combatants \"\n        \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n            (hp_after, successes, failures, camp_id, character_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"character_id\": character_id,\n        \"hp_current\": hp_after,\n        \"hp_max\": row[\"hp_max\"],\n        \"status\": status,\n        \"successes\": successes,\n        \"failures\": failures,\n    }\n\n\ndef record_death_save(camp_id, character_id, outcome):\n    \"\"\"Record a death saving throw for a character at 0 HP.\n\n    Returns the updated counters and status on success, None if the\n    character is missing, \"conscious\" if the character is above 0 HP, or\n    \"terminal\" if the character is already stable or dead.\n    \"\"\"\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT hp_current, hp_max, death_save_successes, death_save_failures \"\n            \"FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, character_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        hp_current = row[\"hp_current\"]\n        successes = row[\"death_save_successes\"]\n        failures = row[\"death_save_failures\"]\n        if hp_current > 0:\n            return \"conscious\"\n        if successes >= 3 or failures >= 3:\n            return \"terminal\"\n        if outcome == \"success\":\n            successes += 1\n        else:\n            failures += 1\n        status = _character_status(hp_current, successes, failures)\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? \"\n            \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n            (successes, failures, camp_id, character_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"character_id\": character_id,\n        \"hp_current\": hp_current,\n        \"hp_max\": row[\"hp_max\"],\n        \"status\": status,\n        \"successes\": successes,\n        \"failures\": failures,\n    }\n\n\ndef create_narration(campaign_id, text):\n    \"\"\"Append a narration event to a play campaign.\n\n    Returns the event dict on success, or None if the campaign is missing.\n    \"\"\"\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\", (campaign_id,)).fetchone() is None:\n            return None\n        sequence = _next_narration_sequence(conn, campaign_id)\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (campaign_id, sequence, \"narration\", \"dm\", text),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    return {\"sequence\": sequence, \"kind\": \"narration\", \"actor\": \"dm\", \"text\": text}\n\n\ndef get_play_campaign_member(camp_id, player):\n    \"\"\"Return a player's own character in a play campaign, or None.\n\n    The result has the character_id and name (no class or player) so that\n    a player reads only their own character context.\n    \"\"\"\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT character_id, name FROM play_campaign_members \"\n            \"WHERE campaign_id = ? The turn counter is\n        # advanced at resolution time because a resolution starts the next\n        # player's turn, while intermediate player actions (and travel turns)\n        # do not bump the counter.\n        last_player_row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND actor != ? \"\n            \"ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1\",\n            (campaign_id, row[\"owner\"]),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if last_player_row is None:\n            next_actor = players[(row[\"turn_number\"] - 1) % len(players)]\n        else:\n            last_player = last_player_row[\"actor\"]\n            try:\n                idx = players.index(last_player)\n            except ValueError:\n                idx = (row[\"turn_number\"] - 1) % len(players)\n            next_actor = players[(idx + 1) % len(players)]\n        new_turn_number = row[\"turn_number\"] + 1\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (campaign_id, next_seq, \"resolution\", row[\"owner\"], text),\n        )\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n            (next_actor, new_turn_number, campaign_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"sequence\": next_seq,\n        \"kind\": \"resolution\",\n        \"actor\": row[\"owner\"],\n        \"text\": text,\n        \"next_actor\": next_actor,\n        \"turn_number\": new_turn_number,\n    }\n\n\n\ndef increment_nudge_count(camp_id, message):\n    \"\"\"Increment the nudge counter for a play campaign and log the nudge event.\n\n    Returns the new count on success, or None if the campaign is missing.\n    \"\"\"\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n            (camp_id,),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        new_count = row[\"nudge_count\"] + 1\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = ? Calls `storage.reset_db()` on startup so every server process begins with a clean, initialized database. |\n| `routes.py` | All HTTP route handlers. Validates input, delegates to domain/services/storage, and shapes JSON responses. Common response and access-control patterns are factored into small helpers. |\n| `domain.py` | Pure, side-effect-free D&D 5e math and static tables (XP, modifiers, dice, rests, initiative, etc.). |\n| `services.py` | Higher-level workflows that combine domain logic with storage (e.g., encounter builder, analytics). |\n| `storage.py` | SQLite persistence layer. All SQL lives here; routes never touch the database directly. Includes idempotent schema migrations for columns added across checkpoints. |\n| `run.sh` | Bootstrap and server start script. |\n| `requirements.txt` | Flask dependency pin. |\n| `VERSION-PINS.json` | Shared version metadata for the benchmark harness. |\n| `game.db` | SQLite database file created automatically next to `app.py`. |\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence\n\n- Storage is provided by SQLite in `game.db`.\n- The schema version is `1` and is hard-coded in `storage.py`.\n- `storage.init_db()` creates tables and back-fills any columns added since the\n  initial schema; `storage.reset_db()` drops and recreates all tables (used by\n  `POST /v1/storage/reset` and by `app.py` on startup).\n- All tables use string primary keys for domain entities (campaigns, combat\n  sessions, users, compendium entries). Junction tables enforce composite keys.\n- Foreign keys are declared in the DDL but are not enabled at runtime; the\n  application enforces referential integrity through the storage layer.\n\n### Request routing\n\nRoutes are grouped in a Flask Blueprint (`api`) and registered in `app.py`.\nThe route layer does three things:\n\n1. Parse and validate the JSON body.\n2. Call the appropriate domain function, service, or storage function.\n3. Return the same JSON body and status code as the previous checkpoint.\n\nRoutes do not contain SQL or business math beyond input validation. Repeated\npatterns—such as \"campaign must exist\" or \"only the owner may access\"—are\nfactored into helpers in `routes.py` so each endpoint reads as a short list of\ncontract checks.\n\n### Determinism\n\n- No randomness is used in responses.\n- Initiative order, combat turn order, and condition decay are deterministic.\n- Passwords are hashed with PBKDF2; the token returned on login is deterministic\n  (`session-{username}`).\n\n## Main API groups\n\n### Core utilities\n\n- `GET /health` — liveness check.\n- `POST /v1/dice/stats` — statistics for expressions like `2d6+3`.\n- `POST
